test.fill_query: INSERT INTO strings_0_15 SELECT substring(hex(cityHash64(number)), 1, number % 16) FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO strings_16_64 SELECT substring(repeat(hex(cityHash64(number)), 4), 1, 16 + number % 49) FROM numbers(4000000)
INSERT INTO strings_0_300 SELECT substring(repeat(hex(cityHash64(number)), 19), 1, number % 301) FROM numbers(1000000)
INSERT INTO strings_1000_2000 SELECT substring(repeat(hex(cityHash64(number)), 125), 1, 1000 + number % 1001) FROM numbers(100000)
INSERT INTO fixed_strings_16 SELECT toFixedString(hex(cityHash64(number)), 16) FROM numbers(5000000)
INSERT INTO fixed_strings_64 SELECT toFixedString(hex(cityHash64(number)), 64) FROM numbers(5000000)
INSERT INTO ipv6s SELECT CAST(toUInt128(cityHash64(number)) * 18446744073709551557 + number AS IPv6) FROM numbers(5000000)
INSERT INTO uint32_values SELECT cityHash64(number) FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO arrays_0_8 SELECT arrayMap(i -> toUInt32(cityHash64(number, i)), range(number % 9)) FROM numbers(3000000)

INSERT INTO maps_0_5 SELECT mapFromArrays(arrayMap(i -> substring(hex(cityHash64(number, i)), 1, 1 + (number + i) % 12), range(number % 6)), arrayMap(i -> number + i, range(number % 6))) FROM numbers(2000000)
INSERT INTO arrays_long_among_short SELECT arrayMap(i -> toUInt32(cityHash64(number, i)), range(number % 256 = 0 ? 1000 : number % 9)) FROM numbers(3000000)
INSERT INTO uint32_nullable_values SELECT cityHash64(number), if(cityHash64(number, 1) % 2 = 0, NULL, toUInt32(cityHash64(number, 2))) FROM numbers(20000000)
